title: The gate between an unreviewed hardware claim and evidence
note: R51 said the scientific tree had no mutation coverage at all, and this is the part of it that matters most: hardware_governance_3d.py decides whether a measurement record counts as reviewed evidence, and PASS staying at zero is exactly the claim that rests on it. H1-H4 attack the intake boundary -- a record that fails its schema must be REJECTED rather than quarantined, and a quarantined record must never acquire evidentiary standing. H5-H9 attack the review binding, which is the confused-deputy surface here: a review must be authored by a human, must decide ACCEPT_AS_EVIDENCE explicitly, and must bind to THIS record by digest rather than merely naming its id, or a reviewed record can be swapped for an unreviewed one after the fact. H10-H11 attack the two constants a reader takes at face value: automatic_gate_effect NONE and can_PASS_now NO.

mutations.name: H1_a_schema_invalid_record_is_quarantined_instead_of_rejected
mutations.rationale: a structurally broken record enters the quarantine report as an ordinary unreviewed claim, so the intake boundary stops distinguishing 'incomplete' from 'not a record at all'

mutations.name: H2_an_unreviewed_record_reaches_the_dossier
mutations.rationale: the dossier is what a reader treats as evidence; admitting a HARDWARE_UNVERIFIED record makes an unreviewed claim indistinguishable from a reviewed one

mutations.name: H3_the_data_class_is_no_longer_checked
mutations.rationale: half of H2: the schema is still enforced and the class that says a human looked at this is not

mutations.name: H4_a_record_with_hard_deficiencies_is_admitted
mutations.find:
hard = [x for x in defs if "UNRESOLVED_REQUIREMENT" not in x]
        if hard:
mutations.replace:
hard = [x for x in defs if "UNRESOLVED_REQUIREMENT" not in x]
        if False:
mutations.rationale: completeness stops meaning zero deficiencies, so a record missing calibration or custody enters the dossier alongside a complete one

mutations.name: H5_a_review_that_did_not_accept_is_treated_as_acceptance
mutations.rationale: a REJECT review admits the record it rejected, which is the strongest possible inversion of a human decision

mutations.name: H6_a_review_authored_by_a_tool_is_accepted
mutations.find:
if rev.get("authored_by_tool"):
        reasons.append("review records authored by tools are invalid by "
mutations.replace:
if False:
        reasons.append("review records authored by tools are invalid by "
mutations.rationale: the human in the loop becomes optional, and a machine-generated review carries the standing of a reviewed one -- which is the failure this entire module exists to make impossible

mutations.name: H7_a_review_need_not_bind_to_the_record_it_reviewed
mutations.rationale: the reviewed record can be modified or replaced after the review, and the review keeps applying to whatever now carries its measurement_id

mutations.name: H8_a_review_with_no_digest_binds_to_anything
mutations.find:
elif record is not None:
        reasons.append("review has no record_sha256 to bind against")
mutations.replace:
elif record is not None:
        pass
mutations.rationale: the same as H7 by omission: a review that names no digest is accepted, so binding becomes optional rather than required

mutations.name: H9_a_malformed_digest_is_accepted
mutations.find:
if len(claimed) != 64 or any(c not in "0123456789abcdef"
                                     for c in claimed.lower()):
mutations.rationale: '-' or 'pending' becomes a valid binding, and the comparison below either never runs or compares against nonsense

mutations.name: H10_the_quarantine_report_claims_a_gate_effect
mutations.rationale: every report in this module states automatic_gate_effect, and NONE is the sentence that keeps an unreviewed hardware claim from moving a gate on its own. A reader takes it at face value

mutations.name: H11_a_quarantined_claim_is_given_standing
mutations.find:
"standing": "unreviewed hardware claim -- no evidentiary "
                        "standing; never enters dossiers",
mutations.rationale: the quarantine report is read by people deciding what to trust, and 'provisional evidence' and 'no evidentiary standing' license completely different actions
